name: video-text
title: Video Text
description: Big text used as a window onto a video: the footage plays only inside the letters (bold, centred, fitted to the box).

moworks.author: magicui

credit.author: Magic UI (magicuidesign)
credit.madeNote: ported to GSAP on the film's clock; same timings, eases, sizes and colours; the original is linked

moworks.notes: The <video> is a normal HyperFrames clip (class clip, data-start, data-duration, muted) inside an untimed holder. The mask is drawn with the font named in `font`, so give the film a font with Vietnamese letters.
moworks.titleVi: Video chạy bên trong nét chữ
